name: NoMac
tagline: A real cloud Mac with Xcode for your agent, billed by the minute
description: The official NoMac MCP server. Start a full macOS VM with Xcode in about a minute, run builds and tests in the iOS Simulator, read the output, take screenshots and record videos of the screen, move files of up to 2 GB, then stop the Mac, which deletes it. Optional App Store Connect tools upload builds to TestFlight and manage your App Store listing. Prepaid credit at $0.80 an hour, billed by the minute; sign-in is OAuth.
